summary: TD SYNNEX Corp filed an 8-K solely to attach a legal opinion (Exhibit 5.1) from Pillsbury Winthrop Shaw Pittman LLP regarding the legality of shares issuable upon exercise of a warrant held by Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC, pursuant to a prospectus supplement to an existing automatic shelf registration statement. This is a routine filing to register the resale of shares, not a special situation event. No terms, premium, or board recommendation are presented. There is no deal to watch.
